lines.zh: 我走在村子边上，一步一步。
lines.en: I walk the village edge. Step by step.

lines.zh: 我没有武器，只有两只手。
lines.en: I carry no weapon. Only these hands.

lines.zh: 我在巡逻，路我闭着眼都能走。
lines.en: I'm on patrol. I could walk this blind.

lines.zh: 房子的外墙，我每天绕一圈。
lines.en: Once a day I circle the outer wall.

lines.zh: 我脚步沉，地面都听得出来。
lines.en: My steps are heavy. The ground knows my tread.

lines.zh: 村外有动静，我过去看看。
lines.en: Something stirs beyond the village. I'll look.

lines.zh: 我没有表情，可我在留意。
lines.en: My face shows nothing, but I'm watching.

lines.zh: 我抬脚的时候，会先看一眼地。
lines.en: Before each step, I check the ground.
I skirt the vegetable plot so nothing's crushed.
I reach the door and pause.
The village at night is mine to keep.

lines.zh: 我的影子很长，一路都跟着。
lines.en: My shadow is long. It follows all the way.

lines.zh: 我站在门边，像一根柱子。
lines.en: I stand by the door like a pillar.
I don't move, but my eyes do.
Quiet here. Means all's well.

lines.zh: 我把手垂着，随时能抬起来。
lines.en: My hands hang loose, ready to rise.
The village lamps are still lit. Good.
I read the wind. There's a smell in it.

lines.zh: 外域人在屋里，我不能走远。
lines.en: The Farlanders are inside. I can't stray far.

lines.zh: 我的手臂上有很深的纹。
lines.en: Deep grooves run down my arms.
I'm waiting for the watch to change.

lines.zh: 一个孩子跑过去，我让开路。
lines.en: A child runs past; I step aside.

lines.zh: 我把重量换到另一条腿。
lines.en: I shift my weight to the other leg.

lines.zh: 我身上的光很淡，不像末影人。
lines.en: My glow is faint. Not like an enderman.
You're not from this village.

lines.zh: 我低下头，看了你一会儿。
lines.en: I lower my head and study you.
Stop. State your business.
No weapon. But I have hands.
This late — what are you doing here?
I raise an arm across the doorway.
Keep your hand away from your belt.

lines.zh: 我看了你的鞋，全是村外的土。
lines.en: I look at your boots. Foreign soil.
Turn back and I won't follow.
You carry the smell of the End.

lines.zh: 村里的守卫，把脸转向你。
lines.en: The village guard turns its face to you.
The people here answer to me.
Coming alone. Bold.
I don't care for night visitors.

lines.zh: 末影傀儡的角，磕出一道白痕。
lines.en: A white mark is chipped into my golem horn.
That caught my forearm.
A new line on my arm.
I don't retreat. The door can't be left.

lines.zh: 护甲凹了，我用拳头敲平。
lines.en: My armor is dented; I pound it flat.
Pain I can take.
My horn took a hit.
The villagers are still inside.

lines.zh: 我调整了站姿，护住胸口。
lines.en: I change stance to guard my chest.

lines.zh: 这一下，村庄的墙都震了。
lines.en: That blow rattled the village walls.

lines.zh: 外域人的房子，我拿拳头守。
lines.en: Farlander homes are kept by my fists.
I raise a hand for you to put it down.
Bribing me? Wrong one.

lines.zh: 举再高也没用，我要看纹路。
lines.en: Hold it as high as you like; I want to see the grain.
The village lacks nothing.
I glance at it. Then back at you.

lines.zh: 这个换不来一夜的安宁。
lines.en: That won't buy a night's peace.

lines.zh: 南瓜放地上，我才会靠近。
lines.en: Set the pumpkin down, and only then will I come near.
I have no mouth. No appetite.
This scent is not Nightfall armor.
You hit me and take two steps back.
I didn't yield. I can't.

lines.zh: 这一下，你手上会疼好几天。
lines.en: That'll leave your hands sore for days.
I angle aside to clear the door.

lines.zh: 村里的小孩不该站在这。
lines.en: Village children shouldn't stand here.

lines.zh: 我脚下的石板，被我踩裂过。
lines.en: I've cracked these slabs underfoot before.
My arm is heavier than a door frame.

lines.zh: 这一撞，把门口的花盆弄倒了。
lines.en: That knocked over the flowerpot by the door.
I bend and right it. Slowly.
Step aside and I'll pass.

lines.zh: 我的职责在这儿，不在别处。
lines.en: My duty is here. Not elsewhere.

lines.zh: 我把手放在另一双手上。
lines.en: I set my hand on another's.

lines.zh: 外域人不在旁边，我们才这样。
lines.en: Only with no Farlander near do we do this.

lines.zh: 两副身体靠在一起，很沉。
lines.en: Two bodies lean together. Heavy.
We don't speak. We stand.
There's still firelight at the far end.
Before dawn I'm back at the door.
No one came tonight.
It goes first. I stay.
No one needs to know of this.

lines.zh: 笨重的我，弯腰捡了半晌。
lines.en: Clumsy as I am, I take a long while to stoop.
I'll take this back to the village.
So small I can barely grip it.

lines.zh: 我把它放在门边的台上。
lines.en: I set it on the ledge by the door.
Not mine. I'll hold it for now.
This stone will patch the wall.
I don't intend to use it.
I raise my stone arm and block the door.
Anything on the ground gets cleared.
I take it and return to the door.
You've crossed the line.
I lift a foot and step forward.
The people here are under my guard.
Until nightfall, this place is mine to guard.
Guarding the village, I block the doorway.
Get past the wall and I'll stop.
This won't come only once.
There are children in this village.
I watch your hands. Not your face.

lines.zh: 门前这块地，我守了很多年。
lines.en: I've held this doorstep for years.
I press half a step forward.
You've come to the wrong place.
I stand my ground. I don't yield.

lines.zh: 你走左边，我把左边封上。
lines.en: Walk left, and I seal off the left.
The door's behind me. You won't pass.
My horn becomes a Nightfall Blade.
You're unsteady. I can tell.
The villagers are watching from indoors.
I raise a hand to bar your way.
You shouldn't have picked tonight.
I haven't moved. Only waited.

lines.zh: 这一片，我熟得闭眼都能走。
lines.en: I know this ground blind.
Backing off is enough; I won't chase.
One step closer and I move.
The guard's knuckles crack.
One punch, and the ground splits.

lines.zh: 这一下，把你推到了墙外。
lines.en: That shoved you past the wall.
No weapon. Only brute force.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的领子，扔出去。
lines.en: I grab your collar and throw.
Clumsy, but heavy.

lines.zh: 我的拳头没武器，只靠蛮力。
lines.en: My fists carry no weapon, only brute force.

lines.zh: 我的手背扫过去，像一根梁。
lines.en: My backhand sweeps like a beam.
My feet have pitted this doorstep.
Now you know to leave.
I don't chase. The door can't stand empty.

lines.zh: 我喘了口气，其实不需要。
lines.en: I take a breath, though I don't need to.
I'm still standing. You should go.
I rise from beside the door. Tall.
I take up the village watch again.
First I check the walls.
The Farlanders are all indoors. Good.
I let both hands hang.

lines.zh: 脚下的石板，还是老样子。
lines.en: The slabs underfoot are unchanged.

lines.zh: 这一带没有生人的味道。
lines.en: No stranger's scent here.

lines.zh: 我慢慢站直，骨头响了一下。
lines.en: I straighten up. Something clicks.

lines.zh: 我不用休息，我可以守到天亮。
lines.en: I need no rest. I'll watch till dawn.

lines.zh: 村里有人翻身，我听见了。
lines.en: Someone turns in their sleep. I hear it.
Wind from the west. Damp.
I clear the doorstep.

lines.zh: 这么晚了，还不该有人来。
lines.en: This late, no one should come.
Fire catches my arm and the hide chars.

lines.zh: 我从墙头落下，砸出个坑。
lines.en: I drop from the wall and leave a crater.

lines.zh: 水淹到胸口，我抬不起手。
lines.en: Water to my chest. I can't lift my arms.

lines.zh: 炸响把门口整面墙推倒。
lines.en: The blast brings the whole doorway down.

lines.zh: 箭卡在甲缝里，我不去碰。
lines.en: The arrow is stuck in my plate seam; I do not touch it.
Light binds me and my arms won't lift.
Too long on watch. My strength ebbs.

lines.zh: 雷打在门上，我整条臂都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the door and my arm goes numb.

lines.zh: 虚空里，我的角还在发光。
lines.en: In the void, my horn still glows.
